reports.title: Mia Gauci-Lamport: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

promises.quote: the CQC inform us that they are monitoring the service to ensure that children residing there are not exposed to risk or unsafe care, which is of utmost importance so deaths such as Mia's can be prevented. CQC regulates the premises and the care provided, and they are reviewing any information received to help inform the next inspection.
promises.summary: CQC monitoring service to prevent unsafe care

promises.quote: NHSE have provided assurance that their regional team has been working with system and other partners on responding to risks and concerns in a joint approach at this provider, which will be set out in their response.
promises.summary: NHSE working with partners on risk response

promises.quote: The Government is supportive of the review on the duty it inherited from the previous administration and will consider the findings, recently published on 26 November, following a call for evidence in April this year. The government will consider these findings alongside findings from the ongoing manager regulation consultation as it continues to develop policy on candour in healthcare.
promises.summary: Government to consider duty of candour findings

promises.quote: On 18th October 2023 CQC requested the outcome of the external investigation from the registered manager at TCT. This wasn't available, but TCT shared the findings with CQC of the internal investigation. Alongside the evidence of findings from the Ofsted inspection the CQC made the decision to await the external investigation findings before scheduling an inspection.
promises.summary: CQC will wait for Ofsted inspection results before scheduling inspection
promises.timescale: await the outcome of Ofsted's inspection
